about.heading: ABOUT
about.body:
I was born and raised in Venezuela, with Italian roots on both sides of my family. In 2018, I moved to Barcelona, Spain, where I’m currently based.

With a background in Architecture and Interior Design, I eventually found my path in modeling, a career I’ve been pursuing for over 15 years. Throughout this time, I’ve had the opportunity to work on a wide range of advertising and fashion campaigns for both national and international brands.

My experience spans both freelance projects and agency collaborations, allowing me to work across different creative environments and alongside a variety of teams.

I enjoy the diversity that modeling brings, and I approach every project with versatility, commitment, and a genuine interest in bringing each vision to life.
